justifications.durability: The deliverable is a durable report at a stable path. The repair is named as concrete arguments the existing pair builders already take (field_scale_t, initial_level_wb) plus a driver-only trace change, with no solver change, and the confirming measurement is specified to the fixture, seed digest, clip, lane and rung. Held below full because the central attribution is left explicitly unproven (the receipts carry no per-step trace) and the node is an investigation with no committed code or guard; a reader must run the named receipt to settle it.
justifications.evidence: The report restates the measured state value-for-value against the plan section 2 records (row residual 1.3398458394898267e-03, gauge-free offset -1.6463130685184867e-02 of span, three-column 2.3214644865632295e-03 and -1.8962439950152867e-02, amplitudes [2.388599064870474e-03, -1.1059397227966279e-13, 1.2383665193033397], bound_refusal all false), and I independently resolved each code anchor it cites except one. Verified present and as characterised: compensator_step returns step = -row_residual (constraint.py:460); BoundedExteriorFieldUnknown.damped_step caps by min(1, step_limit/|r|), backtracks on a halving ladder, and sets step = 0 on a refusal (constraint.py:583); assemble_augmented_system (constraint.py:1883) is the G builder; _relative_residual is max|g-x|/max|g| (fixed_point.py:1050); the certificate driver uses recovery.NEWTON_STEPS and recovery.KRYLOV_ITERATIONS, whose values are 10 and 30 (measure.py:51-52); the GMRES is restart=maxiter=gmres_iterations with a zero initial guess and identity preconditioner (fixed_point.py:2623) and _certificate_solve_request is at solovev_certificate.py:2176; the fixture defaults DEFAULT_FIELD_SCALE_T=1e-3, DEFAULT_STEP_LIMIT=1.0, DEFAULT_LEVEL_SCALE_WB=1.0 hold and the level column is unbounded (level_bound_wb None, level_bound_is_field_bound False) with initial_level_wb defaulting to None. Held below full for one fabricated symbol: the report cites 'ForwardProfile.solve_with_constraints (forward.py:2179)', but no solve_with_constraints exists anywhere in the tree; line 2179 is the fixed_point.newton_krylov call inside ForwardProfile._solve_augmented_constraints (forward.py:2117), so the line resolves but the method name does not.
justifications.fit: The report is scoped to plan section 2, targets the modules that section owns (nova/equilibrium/constraint.py, scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/centroid_row.py, the receipt driver), and carries no plan/ticket labels in any symbol; job ids, commit shas and clause labels appear only as artifact identifiers. It corrects the plan's own reading of the 1/286 ratio (the unit-gain u-update, not a Newton under-step), which the plan itself flagged as open, rather than silently restated it.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The report answers exactly the node goal: it attributes why the three-column constrained solve reaches the analytic centroid but not the 1e-12 fixed point (verdict: the whole augmented iterate is still unconverged when the fixed 10-step/30-GMRES budget runs out, with the terminal residual carried by the flux block, not the row), rules the four gate candidates in or out with evidence each way, proposes one repair (field_scale_t 0.25 T, a seeded initial_level_wb, a per-step trace), and names the single GPU-class receipt that would confirm or refute it. It also addresses all four gate clauses including the CPU-abort ownership. I confirmed the load-bearing numbers it rests on reproduce: the compensated column scale 1.627789 m/T x 1e-3 T / 0.46606 m = 3.4927e-3 (the report's 1/286), the vertical leverage 4.916664e-3/0.46606 = 1.055e-2, the compensator flux pi x 2.3886e-3 x (7.718433652945465^2 - 6.2^2) = 0.15859 Wb = 3.217e-3 of the 49.2965 Wb span, and the two/three-column terminal max|g-x| 1.606e-3 / 2.651e-3 both above their rows' 1.34e-3 / 2.32e-3.
justifications.scope_discipline: The node is read-only investigation with a single granted write path, the report; the worktree is clean at head (tree-snapshot status_entries empty) and the run made no commit, so nothing outside the fence was touched. The report stays in its lane and explicitly reports the CPU-abort ownership, the span-clause inconsistency and the damped_step defects as follow-ons for other sections rather than repairing them.
